HOSTEL RULES AND REGULATIONS
(Applicable to all students residing in the University Hostels)
These rules are framed to ensure discipline, safety, hygiene, academic focus, and
harmonious living within the hostel premises. All hostel residents shall strictly comply with
these regulations during their period of stay in the University hostel.
1. Eligibility and Authorised Occupancy
1.1 Hostel accommodation is provided only to students who have been officially allotted
rooms by the University .
1.2 Students shall occupy only the room /bed allotted to them and shall not change rooms or
exchange accommodation without prior written approval of the Warden.
1.3 Hostel rooms are not transferable under any circumstances .
1.4 No resident shall allow day scholars, visitors, or unauthorized persons to stay inside
hostel rooms.
1.5 The University reserves the right to reallocate or shift any hostel resident to alternate
accommodation of similar configuration wit hin the hostel system at any time, if required,
due to administrative, operational, maintenance, safety, or disciplinary considerations .
Students shall comply with such directions issued by the Warden or authorized University
authorities.
2. Hostel In -Time and Attendance
2.1 All hostel residents shall return to the hostel on or before 9:30 PM on all days , unless
prior permission has been obtained from the Warden or authorized official.
2.2 Attendance shall be taken after the prescribed in -time every night a nd all residents must
mark attendance mandatorily .
2.3 Repeated violation of in -time or absence during attendance may result in disciplinary
action .
3. Visitors and Entry Restrictions
3.1 Entry of non-residents, day scholars, or visitors into hostel rooms is strictly prohibited.
3.2 Visitors, if permitted, shall remain only in designated visitor areas during approved
visiting hours .
3.3 Residents shall be responsible for the conduct of their visitors within hostel premises.

4. Prohibition of Alcohol
4.1 Possession, consumption, storage, distribution, or sale of alcoholic within the hostel and
campus premises is strictly prohibited.
4.2 Entering the hostel or campus under the influence of alcohol shall be treated as serious
misconduct.
4.3 Violations will result in disciplinary action including suspension or removal from
hostel facilities and other penalties as determined by the University authorities .
5. Smoking and Tobacco Use
5.1 Smoking or use of tobacco products, e -cigarettes, or similar substances is strictly
prohibited inside hostel buildings and across the University campus.
6. Prohibition of Narcotic Drugs and
Prohibited Substances
6.1 Possession, consumption, storage, purchase, sale, or distribution of narcotic drugs,
psychotropic substances, or any prohibited intoxicating substances is strictly prohibited.
6.2 Such violations shall be treated as serious misconduct and may result in disciplinary
action including immediate expulsion from the hostel and/or the University , in addition to
action un der applicable laws.
6.3 If any prohibited substance is found in a hostel room, the occupants of the room will be
held jointly responsible unless proven otherwise during inquiry .
7. Ragging, Harassment, and Misconduct
7.1 Ragging in any form is strictly prohibited as per UGC Regulations on Curbing the
Menace of Ragging in Higher Educational Institutions .
7.2 Any form of physical harassment, mental harassment, bullying, abusive language,
intimidation, quarrelling, or viol ent behaviour is strictly prohibited.
7.3 Violations will attract strict disciplinary action in accordance with university
regulations and applicable law .
8. Academic Environment and Quiet Hours
8.1 The hostel premises are intended to support academic pursuits and a peaceful study
environment .

8.2 Students shall maintain silence during quiet hours between 10:00 PM and 6:00 AM .
8.3 Loud music, parties, celebrations, or gatherings inside hostel premises are not permitted.
9. Gambling and Commercial Activi ties
9.1 Gambling in any form, including betting and card gambling, is strictly prohibited.
9.2 Residents shall not engage in Multi -Level Marketing (MLM) activities, commercial
solicitation, or business activities within the hostel premises .
10. Hostel Pro perty and Damage
10.1 Students shall take proper care of all hostel property including furniture, fixtures,
electrical fittings, plumbing installations, taps, mirrors, and other facilities .
10.2 Any damage caused intentionally or due to negligence shall be repaired or replaced at
the cost of the concerned student(s) .
10.3 Where individual responsibility cannot be determined, the cost will be recovered
collectively from all occupants of the ro om or concerned hostel block .
11. Cleanliness and Maintenance
11.1 Residents shall maintain cleanliness and hygiene within their rooms and common areas.
11.2 Writing on walls, fixing nails, placing posters or stickers without permission, or
damaging surfac es is prohibited.
12. Food and Hygiene Regulations
12.1 Students shall not carry or store food items in hostel rooms , as this may lead to pest
infestation, hygiene issues, and unpleasant odour.
12.2 All meals shall ordinarily be consumed in the designated dining facilities of the
University mess or approved dining areas .
12.3 In cases where a student is unable to visit the dining hall due to illness , food may be
sent to the hostel room only upon recommendation or prescription from the Campus
Medical Officer or University doctor .
12.4 In such circumstances, the responsibility for collecting the food from the mess and
delivering it to the room shall rest with the concerned student's roommate or a fellow
hostel resident .

12.5 Students receiving food in their rooms shall ensure proper disposal of leftovers and
return of utensils to maintain cleanliness and hygiene .
13. Electrical Appliances and Fire Safety
13.1 Students shall not keep or use unauthorised electrical applianc es such as immersion
rods, heaters, hot plates, electrical iron board or cooking devices inside hostel rooms.
13.2 Such appliances pose serious fire hazards and may be confiscated by hostel authorities.
13.3 Tampering with fire safety equipment, alarms, ex tinguishers, or electrical
installations is strictly prohibited.
14. Vehicles
14.1 Hostel residents shall not bring or keep motor vehicles inside the campus or hostel
premises unless specifically permitted by the University.
15. Presence During Academic Ho urs
15.1 Students are expected to attend classes regularly.
15.2 No student shall remain in the hostel during academic hours unless permitted by the
Campus Medical Officer or an authorized University authority .
16. Personal Valuables
16.1 Students are advi sed not to keep large sums of cash, jewellery, or other valuable
items in their rooms.
16.2 The University shall not be responsible for any loss, theft, or damage to personal
belongings kept in hostel rooms.
17. Hostel & Mess Facilities – Applicability,
Menu Policy, and Extended Stay Charges
17.1. From 1st August 2026 Only one common menu will be served for all Students, with
vegetarian and non -vegetarian options.
17.2 The Hostel and Mess Fees collected by the University are applicable only for the
regular academic period of ten (10) months, from August to May of the respective academic
year. Accommodation and mess facilities required beyond this period, including
summer vacations, internships, placement training, project work, or any other extended stay,
shall be charged separately as per the prevailing rates and University policy.

18. Feedback : Hostel & Mess Facilities
18.1. I, understand that the hostel administration is committed to providing timely repair and
maintenance of rooms, and nutritious meals as per the menu approved by the Student Mess
Committee. I agree to report any concerns regarding facilities or food through the designated
grievance redressal system, providing clear and specific details to help the team address
issues effectively.
18.2. I, acknowledge that food preferences can be personal, and the mess committee works
to balance diverse tastes while following t he agreed menu. (Students who wish to contribute
to menu planning are encouraged to participate in the Student Mess Committee ).
18.3. I, appreciate that the hostel fees contribute to the defined set of services and facilities
offered, and I will direct feedback constructively through proper channels so the
administration can serve all residents fairly.
18.4. I, understand that following t hese guidelines helps maintain a positive living
environment for everyone in the hostel community.
19. Out -Pass and Leaving Campus
17.1 Students may leave the campus only with a valid out -pass issued by the Warden or
authorized authority after obtaining confirmation from parents .
17.2 Students shall not stay outside overnight without prior written permission from the
Warden .
19. Right of Inspection and Search
19.1. The Warden or authorized University officials may inspect hostel rooms at any time
in the interest of safety, maintenance, or discipline.
19.2. Any prohibited items found during inspection may be confiscated , and appropriate
disciplinary action will be initiated.
20. Emergency Powers of the Warden
20.1. In situations involving safety concerns, misconduct, or emergency , the Warden or
authorized University official may take immediate preventive or corrective action .
20.2. Such action may include temporary suspension of hostel privileges pending
disciplinary review .

21. Disciplinary Authority
21.1. Violation of any hostel rule shall be reported to the hostel administration and
University disciplinary authorities .
21.2. The University reserves the right to impose appropriate disciplinary measures.
including warning, fine, suspension from hostel facilities, or removal from hostel
accommodation as given at Student Code of Conduct Policy of SRM University – AP :
SRMAP / Reg. Off/ Policies/ 21 / 2025 -26.

21.3. Parents or guardians may be informed in cases involving serious violations or repeated.
misconduct

Declaration
I hereby declare that I have read, understood, and agree to abide by the Hostel Rules and
Regulations of the University . I understand that violation of these rules may result in
disciplinary action including suspension or removal from hostel facilities and/or other action
as per university regulations.
